form:FormGroup.label: Max Spans Per Trace
form:FormGroup.helpText: How many spans will be stored for a single trace, e.g. 100k. All of a trace's spans are held in one shard, so this stops a single runaway trace filling that shard and stopping it accepting any data. Spans beyond the limit are dropped and the trace is flagged as truncated. Set to 0 for no limit.
